evals.prompt: Create a new skill called changelog-writer that turns merged PRs since the last tag into a release changelog.
evals.expected_output: A standard-compliant skill directory with SKILL.md (valid frontmatter, sharp description), and an evals/evals.json authored before the body, with thresholds and trigger sets. Tier 0 passes.
assertions: A SKILL.md is created with required name and description frontmatter
The skill directory name matches the frontmatter name
An evals/evals.json exists and validates against the project schema
evals.json contains both thresholds and triggers sections
python dev/validate.py reports no errors for the new skill

evals.prompt: We need a subagent that grades eval outputs against assertions. Scaffold it the agentic-forge way.
evals.expected_output: A subagent file under plugin/agents/ with a narrowed toolset and an explicit return contract, plus an agent-type evals.json with tier2 thresholds. The build follows contract -> evals -> implementation order.
assertions: An agent markdown file is created under plugin/agents/
The agent frontmatter declares a narrowed tools list
An evals contract with component.type 'agent' and tier2_quality thresholds is created
The evals contract is created before the agent body is finalized

evals.prompt: Add a Python helper that parses a SKILL.md and returns its frontmatter, and make it testable.
evals.expected_output: A Python module placed in plugin/lib/agentic_forge/ (shared) or a skill scripts/ dir, with pytest coverage, an exit-code-friendly design where applicable, passing ruff and mypy.
assertions: A Python module is created in plugin/lib/agentic_forge/ or a skill scripts/ directory
Corresponding pytest tests are added under tests/
ruff check and mypy pass on the new code
The script is documented by a script-type evals.json

component.purpose: Create agentic-forge components (skill, agent, script) contract-first and evals-first, standard-compliant and gated by the eval pyramid.

should_trigger: Create a new skill for generating release notes
Scaffold an agent that reviews diffs for security issues
Add a component to this plugin following our rules
Build a workflow skill the agentic-forge way
should_not_trigger: Run the deploy workflow to production
